free_tier.stated: No free tier of this product: 超级会员 is sold by the month. The non-member download path is the vendor's own baseline, and its speed table lists 586 KB/s for the un-membered path against 15.8 MB/s for 超级会员.
free_tier.notes: The speed table was seen only through the search index of vip.xunlei.com. The page itself answered 403 to every reader.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. 云添加 accepts up to 500 files per submission and the drive is 10 to 12 TB, so the practical unit is a task, not a byte.

retention.stated: 云盘回收站保留60天: a deleted file is recoverable for 60 days. Files not deleted are kept while the membership runs.

egress.terms: The membership includes 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回: 10 TB of high-speed retrieval from the cloud drive per month. Retrieval is not priced per byte; it is a monthly allowance inside the membership.
egress.free_allowance: 10 TB/month of 云盘高速取回

interface_detail: Vendor client only. 云添加 takes magnet, ed2k and http(s) links, and third-party tools drive it through the client's own endpoints rather than a published API. No public API was found on any page read.
tooling: Official Windows, macOS, Android and iOS clients; the 云添加 queue accepts magnet/ed2k/http in batch. No rclone backend exists for 迅雷云盘.
chaining: The cheapest per-byte retrieval measured: at the 11.11 price of ¥298 for 30 months (¥9.93/month) with 10 TB/month of cloud retrieval, a 1 TiB month consumes a tenth of the allowance and costs about ¥1 of membership.

limits.value: 10 TB/month 云盘高速取回; upload 240 GB/day and 1 TB/month
1000 次云添加/天, 500 files per submission
10 并行下载; the vendor speed table puts 超级会员 at 15.8 MB/s against 586 KB/s un-membered

identity_cost.detail: The client's login offers a phone number plus 微信/QQ QR login. No email-only path was found and the login page at i.xunlei.com returned an empty document to every reader tried, so whether a non-mainland number is accepted was not established. Phone is the gate; the country rule is unverified.

reliability_note: a lapsed membership stops retrieval of files already stored.
confidence_note: Prices and quotas come from IT之家 and 新浪 quoting the vendor's own promotion pages on 2026-10-13 and 2026-05-15. vip.xunlei.com answered 403 to five readers, so the primary page was not read. One purchase and one 云添加 would raise this to measured.

evidence.proved: 30-month 券后 298 元 (9.93 元/月), 年卡 360 元, 连续包年 264 元; '12T 云盘空间、每天 1000 次云添加'; '下载超级加速'
'云盘空间达12TB，云添加次数为1000次/天，单次可上传500个文件，月度支持10TB云盘高速取回，文件上传流量为240G/天、1T/月，还支持超级通道、10个并行下载，云盘回收站保留60天'
vendor speed table 15.8 MB/s / 7.82 MB/s / 586 KB/s across 超级会员 / 会员 / 非会员; page returned 403, table seen through the search index only
same 30-month deal at ¥298 and 15-month at ¥159 on 2026-10-23; this page calls the drive 10T rather than 12T

price_per_tb_month: CNY 9.93/month at the 30-month price (¥298/30mo); CNY 22/month on 连续包年
notes: Two sources disagree on the drive size: IT之家 and 新浪 say 12 TB, the 会员省 price index says 10 TB. The conservative 10 TB is recorded. 迅雷's 离线 function no longer exists as a standalone product; the cloud-add queue is what replaced it.
binding_note: 10 TB/month of high-speed retrieval is the first wall at 1 TiB/month only if the client also counts uploads; the real constraint for a user is that retrieval is inside a membership, not sold per byte, so the quota binds before any shaping does.
